manual_quality_audit.scope: all accepted records plus stratified samples from the two dominant reject reasons

false_accept_detail.question: Why is it correct to use geometric optics to analyze a microscope image?
false_accept_detail.source_solution: Microscopes create images of macroscopic size, so geometric optics applies.
false_accept_detail.finding: Gate3 conclusion-fragment extraction dropped the causal premise needed to answer the why-question; downstream correctness still accepted it.

gate1_university_level_uncertain_sample.finding: Clear university textbook/statistics questions are being rejected as UNIVERSITY_LEVEL_UNCERTAIN.

gate2_problem_type_uncertain_sample.finding: The prompt allows CONCEPTUAL as positive, but substantive conceptual/proof/calculation questions are rejected when model confidence is below the 0.98 gate threshold.

blockers: Gate3 can extract an incomplete conclusion fragment that loses essential answer semantics and still pass correctness.
Gate1 has material false rejects on clear university-level source questions.
Gate2 has material false rejects because valid positive CONCEPTUAL/PROOF/CALCULATION items are rejected at sub-0.98 confidence.
License provenance is not preserved into exported static_info for the accepted OpenStax record.
